rationale: SkiaCanvas's backdrop-filter paths now blur a mirror-tiled crop of the element's own rect and crop only the output, so a backdrop at a box edge is the box's content reflected as Chrome draws it (core/canvas/src/skia_canvas_opacity.cpp: render-assets-and-backends; the canvas-kernel change event and inheritance entry cover the transferred slice). The backdrop differential fixture gains an edge-mirror box and its manifest viewport grows to 512x260 (test/fixtures/import-differential/22-backdrop-opacity.html and manifest.json: chromium-authoring-frontend). The Chrome oracle prints the profile across that edge (tools/import-validation/chrome_backdrop_opacity_oracle.py: design-output-and-packaging, visual-proof-harness), and the import-design skill notes the mirrored edge (.agents/skills/import-design/SKILL.md: design-source-ingest). No signature, capability or call site changes, and no design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
